body.text: AI sales automation from Teknoppy helps sales teams respond to leads faster, follow up consistently, keep CRM data clean and spend more time selling. We connect your lead sources, CRM, email, WhatsApp and calendar, then add AI to score leads, draft messages and report on your pipeline automatically.

sections.trustline: Reviewed by Sanal Edison, Founder, Teknoppy. Last updated: 17 November 2026.

items.text: Teknoppy: web, software and automation studio in Thykoodam, Kochi, since 2018
Sales work: lead capture, follow-up, lead scoring, CRM automation, meeting booking and reporting
120+ websites delivered; 4.9/5 on Google from 60+ reviews
12 in-house staff; no outsourced work
Typical timeline: 2 to 6 weeks

paragraphs.text: What is AI sales automation? It is the use of software and AI to handle the repetitive parts of selling, such as capturing leads, entering data, sending follow-ups, scheduling meetings and preparing reports, so salespeople can focus on conversations and closing.

Traditional sales automation sends fixed messages on fixed schedules. AI adds judgement: it can read an enquiry, estimate how likely the lead is to buy, suggest the next step and draft a personalised reply for a salesperson to approve.

Most lost deals are not lost to price. They are lost to slow replies, forgotten follow-ups and poor visibility. Leads arrive from websites, ads, WhatsApp, phone calls and portals, and many never reach the CRM. Salespeople spend hours on admin. Managers cannot see which deals are stuck.
Sales automation fixes these gaps by making sure every lead is captured, contacted quickly and tracked until it closes or is clearly lost.

items.title: Lead Generation Automation
items.text: Lead generation automation captures enquiries from your website, landing pages, Meta and Google lead forms, marketplaces and email into one place, removes duplicates and assigns each lead to the right salesperson instantly.

items.title: Automated Lead Follow-Up
items.html: Automated lead follow-up contacts new leads within minutes by email or WhatsApp, then sends a planned sequence of reminders if they do not respond. Follow-ups stop automatically when the lead replies or books a meeting.

items.title: AI Lead Scoring
items.text: AI lead scoring ranks leads by how likely they are to buy, using details such as source, budget, location, company size, pages visited and how they respond. Salespeople call the hottest leads first.

items.title: Lead Enrichment Automation
items.text: Lead enrichment automation adds missing details, such as company name, website, industry and role, from approved data sources, so salespeople have context before the first call.

items.title: Meeting Booking Automation
items.text: Meeting booking automation lets qualified leads pick a time from your team's calendars, sends confirmations and reminders, and logs the meeting in your CRM.

items.title: AI Sales Assistant and Email Drafting
items.text: An AI sales assistant summarises a lead's history, suggests next steps and prepares call notes. AI sales email drafting writes personalised follow-ups and proposals based on the conversation so far, ready for a salesperson to review and send.

items.title: Sales Reporting Automation
items.text: Sales reporting automation sends daily or weekly summaries of new leads, pipeline value, conversion rates, deals at risk and salesperson activity to managers, without anyone building spreadsheets.

sections.intro: CRM automation keeps your CRM accurate without constant manual updates. Calls, emails, WhatsApp messages and meetings are logged automatically, deal stages update when key events happen, and tasks are created for the next step.

items.title: Zoho CRM Automation
items.text: Zoho CRM automation is popular with Indian businesses. We set up workflows, blueprints, lead assignment rules and integrations with Zoho Books, WhatsApp and your website, and add AI steps where they help.

items.title: HubSpot Automation
items.text: HubSpot automation covers workflows, sequences, lead scoring, deal pipelines and reporting, plus integrations with tools HubSpot does not connect to natively.

items.title: Sales Pipeline Automation
items.text: Sales pipeline automation moves deals through stages based on real activity, alerts salespeople about stalled deals and reminds managers when large opportunities need attention.

items.title: CRM Data Cleanup Automation
items.text: CRM data cleanup automation finds duplicates, fixes formatting, fills missing fields and flags outdated records, so reports and AI scoring are based on reliable data.

paragraphs.text: Does AI lead scoring work? Yes, when there is enough history to learn from and the scoring is checked against real outcomes. A business with a few hundred closed deals can usually build a useful model. With less data, we start with simple rule-based scoring and add AI as data grows. We review scores against actual sales every month and adjust.

items.title: Automobile Dealers
items.text: AI sales automation for automobile dealers captures enquiries from websites and marketplaces, books test drives, follows up after showroom visits, sends finance and offer details, and reminds sales staff about hot prospects.

items.title: B2B Companies
items.text: AI sales automation for B2B companies handles longer sales cycles with multiple contacts, enriches company data, tracks proposal stages and keeps follow-ups going for weeks or months without salespeople losing track.

paragraphs.text: Real estate developers, education providers, travel agencies and service companies use similar setups adapted to their sales process.

sections.intro: Most growing sales teams recognise at least a few of these problems:

items.text: Leads wait hours, or even days, for a first reply
Salespeople keep their own spreadsheets instead of updating the CRM
Nobody knows exactly how many leads came in last month or from which source
Follow-ups stop after one or two attempts
Managers spend Monday mornings building reports by hand
Good leads go cold while salespeople chase poor-fit enquiries

outro.text: Each of these has a practical fix, and most fixes can be set up within weeks using tools you already pay for.

paragraphs.text: We agree on clear measures before building, such as average first response time, follow-up completion, lead-to-meeting rate and time spent on admin. These numbers are recorded before launch and tracked monthly afterwards, so you can see exactly what changed. If a measure does not improve, we investigate and adjust the setup rather than adding more tools.

sections.h2: How Much Does Sales Automation Cost?

paragraphs.text: How much does sales automation cost? It depends on your CRM, number of lead sources, users, AI features and message volumes. Costs include a one-time setup fee, CRM and messaging subscriptions, AI usage charges and optional monthly support starting from Rs. 3,000 per month. We provide a written estimate after reviewing your sales process.
Ask us for a sales automation case study relevant to your industry. We share details only with client approval, and we can show example dashboards and workflows on a call.

items.q: Do we need to change our CRM?
items.a: Not usually. We work with Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive and many other CRMs. If you do not have one yet, we recommend a CRM that fits your team size and budget.
Not when they are written well. Messages use the lead's name, enquiry details and the salesperson's voice, and AI drafts can be reviewed before sending for important leads.

items.q: Can WhatsApp be part of the sales process?
items.a: Yes. WhatsApp replies, follow-ups and meeting reminders can be connected to your CRM using the official WhatsApp Business Platform, so every conversation is recorded and visible to the whole sales team. Managers can then see response times and follow-up activity across every channel in one shared place, every day.
